title: The age question: Inside Cebu’s fight over the juvenile justice law

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The local police chief here supports lowering the age of criminal responsibility, though he concedes he cannot back his stance with data. “Personally, I agree. Kasi marami na tayong incident na ‘yung mga minor offenders natin—’yung lower age—nagkakaroon na sila ng mga offense,” Cebu City Police Colonel Ricky Sumalde said. (We have seen many incidents where minor offenders commit offenses.) In the same answer, he added, “I just don’t have the data. Kaya ‘yun lang ‘yung personal opinion ko on the proposal.
